payload.claim: A `tests_result.status == "skip"` is folded into `"survived"` on the same footing as an actual `pass`, and the failure text this produces (lines 160-171) literally says the witness "ran and passed against its mutant" even when it never ran at all. `skip` on the `tests` role means the repo declared no such gate (or, plausibly, that the repo's `tests` script skips this particular subset for a reason unrelated to the mutant) — an absence of evidence, not evidence the assertion is weak. Collapsing 'never executed' into 'executed and did not notice' misattributes a repo/wiring gap to the witness's quality, and the message asserts an execution that did not happen.
